{"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Dank der Agri-Photovoltaikanlage auf den Dächern der neuen Gewächshäuser der Lubera AG in Buchs (SG) kann das Sonnenlicht gleichzeitig für beide Zwecke genutzt werden.", "gist": "An agri-photovoltaic system on Lubera AG's new greenhouses in Buchs allows simultaneous use of sunlight for two purposes."},
{"type": "number", "quote": "10’700 Quadratmeter", "gist": "The system covers an area of 10,700 square meters."},
{"type": "number", "quote": "750'000 kWh", "gist": "The system generates around 750,000 kWh of solar power annually."},
{"type": "number", "quote": "812 kWp", "gist": "The installed capacity is 812 kWp."},
{"type": "number", "quote": "über 6'600", "gist": "There are over 6,600 photovoltaic modules."},
{"type": "entity", "quote": "ewb", "gist": "ewb is the municipal energy supply company that built the system."},
{"type": "entity", "quote": "Insolight aus Renens (VD)", "gist": "Insolight from Renens (VD) is one of the developers."},
{"type": "entity", "quote": "Reech aus Landquart", "gist": "Reech from Landquart is another developer."},
{"type": "claim", "quote": "Sie sind optimal ins Dach integriert und lichtdurchlässig, so dass für die Stromproduktion 20% und für die Pflanzen im Gewächshaus 80% des Sonnenlichts nutzbar sind.", "gist": "The modules are optimally integrated into the roof and are light-permeable, allowing 20% of sunlight for power generation and 80% for greenhouse plants."}]}
